review.decision: davidmann4 is correct: stock Indexed preserves document RGB samples and ICC; the forced-sRGB proposal is withdrawn. No PR comments/replies are posted.

behavior.stock_indexed: No unconditional document→sRGB normalization; Exact retains encoded document RGB and embedded ICC, including no ICC. Default Indexed→RGB is a representation-only change; explicit profile targets still use CMS.
behavior.matte: Foreground/background and Other picker seeds transform working RGB→document RGB with configured intent/BPC and finite gamut clipping. 50% Gray=#808080, Netscape Gray=#c0c0c0.
behavior.preview: The actual inline and worker preview Sessions copy tool FG/BG and invalidate stale previews when those colors change.
behavior.advanced: Palette Map remains Filter→PhotoCraft→Palette Map and editable Smart Filters. Explicit encoded-sRGB snapshots map back into document RGB. Bundled GIMP collections remain removed; external .gpl/ACT import and three original generated palettes remain.

filter_engine.menu_wiring: 631/631; generated parity-checklist content unchanged. Not functional Photoshop parity.

filter_final.owned_arity_lint: Resolved without suppression: mutually exclusive fixed/resizable modal sizing is represented by a private enum. Other untouched lint blockers remain.

assertions: Exact Indexed and default RGB retain samples and profile
Indexed PSD save/reopen and RGB PSD save retain samples
PSD ICC resource bytes/hash equal the original, or stay absent for untagged
native_fixture_contract.profile_limits: Generated PhotoCraft compatible ICCs, not proprietary Adobe assets or a Photoshop runtime oracle. Tagged PSDs are generated from RGB fixtures; untagged cases explicitly assign none.

performance.stock: No new full-image ICC normalization is introduced into stock Indexed. No new benchmark or speedup claim.
performance.historical: The former3.0976× timing measured the now-withdrawn forced-sRGB path. It is retained only as a historical measurement at its original source, not current performance or Photoshop-parity evidence.

limits.photoshop_runtime: Not available. David’s observed preservation behavior is the requirement. Gray constants follow established named-color conventions, not newly measured Photoshop numeric oracles.
limits.matte_reference: Separate opaque-swatch edit.convertToProfile commands supply the reference; this is a separate command path, not an independent CMS implementation.

cache_corrections.scope: Only owned verification artifacts; no product fallback or user source reset.
cache_corrections.initial_backend_failure: Two missing restack imports were repaired. An incompatible shared algo artifact was invalidated before the successful backend gate.
cache_corrections.filter_failure: The initial shared native CLI lacked filter.paletteMap, and the reused xtask binary embedded the Matte root. No initial filter CLI or wrong-root portability result counts as filter proof. Affected native packages and xtask were invalidated, then the actual command, tests, source-bound xtask and screenshots were exercised.

supersedes: coderabbit-followup.json; historical receipts remain source-scoped rather than being re-labelled as current.
